content.text:
Implemented the monthly depreciation workflow.

Key changes:
- Completely replaced `uUsingRoom` with:
  - `SystemManager.Declaration.UOffice uOffice`, caption `Chi nhánh QL:`
  - `Control.UGridLookUpEdit lookupPlaceID`, caption `Công trình SD:`
- Added current-year and month 1–12 selection.
- Added result filtering and period-search mode with status filtering.
- Added read-only workflows using `FAM_DeviceDepPeriod`:
  - `Preview` — button text `Tính dự kiến`
  - `Post` — button text `Ghi nhận`
  - `Search` and period detail
  - Asset depreciation history
  - `Reverse` with mandatory reason
- Added permission `FAM_DeviceDep_Reverse`.
- Preserved the three existing permission constants exactly.
- Kept `FAM_DeviceDep_EditDep_ForDevice` deprecated; it no longer updates `FAM_Device` master values.
- Removed all active usage of `FAM_DeviceDep_TinhLaiKhauHao`, legacy row-saving, and `FAM_Device.EditDep`.
- Used a code-created DevExpress read-only grid dialog for history and period detail.
- The installed DevExpress version has no existing `XtraInputBox` usage, so reversal uses a compatible `XtraForm` and `MemoEdit` prompt.

Files changed:
- `1.WIN-FORM/FamManager/Device/frmDeviceDep.cs`
- `1.WIN-FORM/FamManager/Device/frmDeviceDep.designer.cs`

Verification:
- FamManager-only compilation with project references disabled: successful, producing `FamManager.dll`.
- IDE diagnostics on both modified files: no errors.
- Full referenced-project build still fails in the unrelated `Account` project, including the known missing `GlobalForm` references and existing `IsVisibleColumn`/`IsNullOrZero` errors.
- No SQL, DAL, other forms, or `.resx` files were changed. No commit was created.
